Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

Assist

Assist

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
skills.desc:
With enough energy, press  to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, causing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the joystick to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Invincibility is granted during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot
skills.desc:
When activating EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method with enough Energy, press  to activate:
Use a dual-handed flamethrower to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive Fire DMG. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invincibility is granted during the fire blast.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Quickly dash forward while spraying flames, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
After using the skill, press  to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Glorious Inferno
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is triggered, Burnice will spray flames for an extended duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail
skills.desc:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to X% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Fire Kindling
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method or EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

cons.name: Kindred Flames
cons.desc:
Increases the limit of Heat from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 Heat.
Increases the DMG Multiplier of the Afterburn effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK.
Additionally, the accumulated fire from the Afterburn effect is increased by 25%.

cons.name: Extra at No Additional Charge
cons.desc: When triggering the Afterburn effect, Thermal Penetration is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of Thermal Penetration, up to a max of 20%.

cons.name: Optimistic by Nature
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Ultimate Fuel Supply
cons.desc:
When an EX Special Attack or Assist Attack hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%.
The max flame spray duration of EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot is increased by 1s.

cons.name: Dance of Fire and Ice
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Burning Invitation
cons.desc:
When Burnice hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, it triggers an additional special Afterburn effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as fire to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume Heat.
After hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, while the move is active, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, special Afterburn effects, and fire effects will ignore 25% of the target's fire.
When EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot's fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is fire, trigger an additional instance of fire DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.
